title: Card across places / landscape montage

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Hold a product constant while its surroundings change so viewers can associate one object with many situations.
strategic_value: A fixed green card over varied travel and activity footage can make Wise’s broad usability feel visually coherent.
demonstration: The green Wise card remains centered while the background cuts between streets, markets, outdoor activities, mountain scenery and people.
practical_value: Compare fixed-product continuity with a montage that also moves the product on each cut.

content_islands.name: Stable product
content_islands.spec: Keep the card large and centered with its logo and chip visible.

content_islands.name: Changing world
content_islands.spec: Cut the full background between contrasting places and activities.

reference_purposes.Expression: The green Wise card remains centered while the background cuts between streets, markets, outdoor activities, mountain scenery and people.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates a fixed card composited over varied real-world footage.

ingredient.name: Green card in a changing scene
ingredient.role: Provide a stable point of recognition.
ingredient.application: In this example, keep the card centered while changing the background footage.
ingredient.scope: Observed campaign composition, not an exclusive brand rule or prescribed duration.
